$comment: Simplest case. Parking policy dominates here: traffic is sparse enough that idle car position matters more than assignment cleverness. Also demonstrates that faster elevators do NOT help when travel distances are too short to reach rated speed.
name: Garden Apartments
notes: Passenger transfer time should use the residential value (1.75s) — luggage, strollers, carts.
Useful as a negative control: increasing ratedSpeedMps here should produce little or no AWT improvement.
